Pratikshay ↗

I’m Pratikshay, a software engineer based in Cleveland, Ohio, with a master’s in Computer Science and a soft spot for solving real problems.

My experience spans enterprise applications at Accenture, production support, backend engineering, and cloud workflows. I enjoy connecting the pieces: a clear API, a reliable database, and an experience that makes sense to the person using it.

AI keeps me curious about what comes next. Dancing gives that curiosity another way to move. Both remind me to experiment, pay attention, and keep improving.
